verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents AI-powered parsing, extraction, classification and splitting of documents, plus schema generation from a prompt. These are data-transformation features. None of them surfaces insights or suggestions about the user's data inside the product. Building a RAG app or agent over parsed data is a developer building block, not a built-in insights feature, so there is no direct evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
